Select the ChEMBL ID, preferred name, maximum clinical phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES for all compounds reported in document CHEMBL4818987. Join docs to compound_records on doc_id, then to molecule_dictionary on molregno, and to compound_structures on molregno. Filter by docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4818987'. Return one row per distinct compound. Sort by molecule_chembl_id.
